title: Regime manager: seamless space/atmosphere/surface transitions
description: The client+server regime state machine that drives seamless transitions: the ship (or player) is always in exactly one regime — space, atmosphere, or surface — and crossing boundaries changes controls, physics, and rendering without any cut, load, or teleport.
acceptanceCriteria: src/shared/regime.ts: Regime = 'space' | 'atmosphere' | 'surface'; regimeFor(pos, planets): resolves the current regime from distance to the nearest planet's atmosphere radius (shared by client and server — the server uses it in the sim tick, TASK-13)

Transition rules: entering atmosphere radius → regime 'atmosphere' (drag ramps per TASK-22 boundary); descending below terrain height + 2 u while slow → 'surface' (VTOL/landing, TASK-29); ascending above atmosphere radius → 'space'. No other transitions allowed (no space→surface direct)

Controls remap on regime change (client): space = full 6-DOF-ish flight (thrust/yaw/pitch/roll); atmosphere = flight + vertical VTOL key; surface (on pad) = walk/look/interact (character mode, TASK-31+). Remap is instant at the boundary crossing frame — no menu, no fade

Server and client always agree on regime: the server sends the regime in entity_update (authoritative); the client's local regimeFor is prediction only — if they disagree for > 500 ms the client snaps to the server regime with a debug warning (divergence test)

Unit tests: boundary math (exact radius, hysteresis: a 50 m hysteresis band prevents flapping when crossing slowly — assert no regime flip within the band), no-direct-space-surface transition, shared function returns identical results for client/server inputs

Integration test: scripted flight through all transitions (space → atmosphere → surface → atmosphere → space) via the sim; regime sequence exact; no duplicate transitions (hysteresis holds under noisy positions ±1 u)

steps.details: regimeFor(pos, planets, current): per-planet atmosphereRadius from TASK-4 data; hysteresis: exit radius = enter radius * 1.05; returns {regime, planetId?}. Pure, deterministic.

SimLoop: before integrating, resolve regime for each ship; regime change → event (client gets it via entity_update.regime); drag/VTOL context switches automatically because integrateShip receives the regime (TASK-22).

src/client/input/controls.ts: ControlScheme per regime (key maps); on regime change (predicted or server-confirmed) swap the active scheme; log the swap (debug). Character-mode keys exist now as a stub (TASK-31 fills the behavior).
Boundary/hysteresis unit tests + the scripted full-transition sim integration test (driving inputs through the real SimLoop). Run full suite + typecheck.

technicalNotes: Hysteresis is the key anti-flap mechanism; without it, a ship idling at the boundary would toggle regimes every tick.
The 500 ms client/server divergence tolerance assumes the client's local planet data is identical (same seed) — divergence beyond that means a bug, not latency.
Regime is per-entity (each ship resolves independently); there is no 'system is in a regime' concept.
